# REQ: LANG-2151 LANG-2152 LANG-2153 LANG-2154
project('demo', 'c', version : '1.0', default_options : ['warning_level=3'])
# Dependencies
glib = dependency('glib-2.0', required : true)
src = files('main.c', 'util.c')
exe = executable('demo', src, dependencies : glib, install : true)
if get_option('tests')
  test('basic', exe, args : ['--count', '31'])
endif
message(f'Built @0@ for @1@')
